# Missions: rules load, natural offers, forced offers, and the sides of the AI ships (spec 36, 37, 41).
newgame last
hc_no_codex_pause
wait 8
log start
expect active == 1
hc_ambush_file
# Offers that the starting system generated by itself (spawn chances apply, so 0 is allowed here).
expect hc_offers_escort >= 0
expect hc_offers_assault >= 0
expect hc_offers_shady >= 0
hc_generate all
wait 3
expect hc_offers_escort >= 1
expect hc_offers_assault >= 1
expect hc_offers_shady >= 1
# Fleet assault: allies are friends of the player and enemies of the stronghold.
expect hc_allies >= 2
expect hc_allies_vs_player == 0
expect hc_allies_vs_target >= 2
# Escort: the freighter is a friend of the player; the raiders are enemies of both.
expect hc_escort_vs_player == 0
expect hc_raiders_vs_escort >= 2
expect hc_raiders_vs_player >= 2
quit
